Unlike the rest of the Rubiaceae family, the tribe contains predominantly perennial and annual herbs with pseudowhorls of leaves and leaflike stipules and is centered in temperate and tropical-mountain regions.

Goodmania | Goodmania is a genus of plants in the family Polygonaceae containing the single species Goodmania luteola.  Its common name is yellow spinecape.  It is a tiny annual herb forming small patches on the ground no more than a few centimeters high and wide.  It has fuzzy club-shaped leaves and bears bright yellow flowers.  The plant is native to California and Nevada.
